ja: そんな目で見つめるなよ 興奮しちゃうじゃないか
en: Don't look at me with that kind of eyes. I'm going to get excited.

ja: 僕が特別に判定してあげるよ
en: I'll make a special decision for you.

ja: 獲物は強ければ強いほどいい
en: If the prey is strong, it's as strong as it is.

ja: 試験韓国に付き合ってくれるのか
en: Will you come with me to the test center?

ja: たいにあなたは僕がやる
わざと怪我したら直してくれるかい?
en: If you get hurt, will you heal me?

ja: 君からはいろいろと感じるものがあるね
en: There are a lot of things you can feel from me.

ja: せっかくやるなら完璧に勝つ
en: If you want to do it, you have to win perfectly.

ja: 試験の時からあなたとは戦ってみたかったんだ
en: I wanted to fight you from the time of the test.
Thank you for your hard work.

ja: メイドの見上げに覚えておきな
en: Remember to look up at the maid.

ja: 技術師に不可能はないの
en: It's impossible for a technician to do that.

ja: どうして僕を そんなに興奮させるんだい
en: Why do you make me so excited?

ja: これ以上はやめておこう
本当に怒られちゃうからね
en: You're really going to get mad at me, aren't you?

ja: 君はおとなしくしててね
たまには君みたいのもいいよね
en: Sometimes it's good to be like you.

ja: やっぱりあなたは最高の兵物だ
en: As expected, you are the best soldier!
I'm going to eat after this.
It's not a good thing to lie.

ja: 僕の言えたことじゃないけど
en: It's not what I said, but...
I have to catch this one, right?

ja: 好きだらけで毒系抜かれちゃ
en: If you just like it, you'll be taken away by the poison.
I can't run away from it.

ja: 誰も仕掛けもございません
ハンター ハンター

en: Is it going to be light soon?
